sources.name: OpenStreetMap, Geofabrik Ontario extract
sources.tier_note: OpenStreetMap tags are tier 0 open-data imports. They are not shown as verified.
sources.notes: Extract file retrieved from Geofabrik. The data licence is ODbL 1.0 and it is share-alike. OSM records stay in data/*/osm-ontario/ and are not mixed into GTFS or municipal files. Contributor usernames are not stored. Phone numbers and email addresses are removed from values, including when they appear under another tag.

sources.name: City of Toronto Park Washroom Facilities
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.
sources.tier_note: Municipal open data is tier 0. It is not shown as verified.
sources.notes: The catalogue page states Open Government Licence – Toronto. The CKAN package washroom-facilities has license_id null; the catalogue page is the licence confirmation. ACCESSIBLE_FEATURES is stored as published text and is not translated into wheelchair=yes. The datastore field note for Status is 0 = closed, 1 = open, 2 = service alert. PostedDate is the date that status was posted. A status older than 30 days is kept and marked derived so it is not counted as a current piece.

sources.name: TTC GTFS-RT accessibility service alerts
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.
sources.tier_note: Tier 4 is a live operator status snapshot. It is not an App measurement and it is not counted as a piece. The committed file is stale until npm run fetch:ttc-alerts is run again.
sources.notes: CKAN package ttc-gtfs-realtime-gtfs-rt, license_id open-government-licence-toronto. The accessibility text endpoint is listed from https://gtfsrt.ttc.ca. Equipment is elevator or escalator when the header names it in English (elevator, escalator) or French (ascenseur, escalier mécanique). The phrase hors service does not name equipment by itself. There is no scheduled workflow.

sources.name: City of Kingston public washrooms
sources.licence_name: Open Data Licence – City of Kingston 1.0
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Data Licence – City of Kingston.
sources.tier_note: Municipal open data is tier 0. It is not shown as verified.
sources.notes: Licence PDF retrieved 2026-11-13. It is based on the Open Government Licence Ontario and grants a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, non-exclusive licence, including commercial use, with the attribution sentence above. The file has no wheelchair column, so wheelchair stays UNKNOWN. POI Type is the code 50. facility_type stores POI Type Description, Washroom. description stores Map Label, the human-readable label. Global ID is not stored as a description. Coordinates are EPSG:3857 and are converted to WGS84.

sources.name: City of Kingston accessible features
sources.licence_name: Open Data Licence – City of Kingston 1.0
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Data Licence – City of Kingston.
sources.tier_note: Municipal open data is tier 0. It is not shown as verified.
sources.notes: Same Kingston Open Data Licence as the public washrooms file. The hub CSV download stayed pending, so this import queried the feature service Accessible_Features_at_Kingston_Facilities in WGS84. Type is stored as the published string. Sidewalk Curb Cut, Ramp, Automated Door Opener, Entrance to Access Interior Elevator, Audible Traffic Control, Barrier-Free Routes, and Assistive Listening are stored on kerb, ramp, automatic_door, elevator, speech_output, access, and hearing_loop. Access Restriction stays a category only. Washroom types become washroom records. The word Accessible in a type name is not stored as wheelchair=yes. The hub CSV, when it is generated, uses EPSG:3857.

sources.name: City of Brampton recreation centres
sources.attribution: City of Brampton, Recreation Centres, CC BY.
sources.tier_note: Municipal open data is tier 0. It is not shown as verified.
sources.notes: The ArcGIS item licenseInfo field is the string CC BY. The hub DCAT record also links https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0. The item itself does not state a version, so no version is asserted as the only statement. Amenity columns are not accessibility facts and are not mapped. Coordinates are EPSG:3857. wheelchair stays UNKNOWN.

sources.name: City of Greater Sudbury fieldhouses
sources.licence_name: Open Data Licence – City of Greater Sudbury
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Data Licence – City of Greater Sudbury.
sources.tier_note: Municipal open data is tier 0. It is not shown as verified.
sources.notes: Licence page retrieved 2026-11-13. It adapts the Open Government Licence Ontario v1.0 and grants a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, non-exclusive licence, including commercial use. The hub title Accessible Parks (Layer) is the feature service layer Field_Houses. Columns describe facility buildings. There is no accessibility column, so wheelchair stays UNKNOWN. CSV coordinates are NAD83 UTM zone 17N converted with the GRS80 ellipsoid and no datum grid. Four rows publish X and Y as 0. Those coordinates are taken from AGOL_Recreation_Bilingual_For_Web_FGDB_V_3/FeatureServer/3 in WGS84, and source_key names that layer. If the service has no Ontario coordinate, lat and lon stay UNKNOWN and the record stays.
